project.name: Leicester Townscape Guide
project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 238 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 335 of 438 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Destination draw
touristAppeal.summary: Leicester has destination-scale depth led by National Space Centre, King Richard III Visitor Centre, Leicester Museum and Art Gallery and Leicester - King Richard's Old City, with enough independent visitor experiences for most of a day.

townGuide.headline: Leicester: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Leicester offers National Space Centre, King Richard III Visitor Centre, Leicester Museum and Art Gallery within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: National Space Centre
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with National Space Centre and King Richard III Visitor Centre, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
